decisions.reason: The same message independently introduces the request for every presented colour variant, which is already represented in this Requirement; selecting rev4-02 and its primary treatment requires no additional change.
Selecting rev4-02 and its color treatment does not change the established business name or strapline wording.
The final design selection does not alter the already completed historical obligation to produce and present the initial concept set.
Approval of a final version and color treatment neither changes nor resolves the independent originality requirement.
The selected primary treatment establishes which visual colors the brand color specification must document and supply for the chosen final logo.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi, oops—I thought I had already replied!

We’d like to proceed with the agreed final version shown above, rev4-02. Thank you!

Am I correct in assuming that the logo will be supplied both with and without the black box, since a black box will not be suitable for every use?

Will we also receive every colour variant you’ve presented?

That said, I believe the primary logo should be the version in the top row of the final design: graduated orange ‘global’, black ‘dough’, and the strapline in graduated orange.

What we now need is the logo guidelines and every file type required for use online, on social media, on the truck itself, and across other hard copy materials, eg pull up banners, printed menus, uniform, etc.

Given that the files will have large file sizes, how will you share them? Wetransfer?

Thank you, [CLIENT_NAME_001]

value_updates.selected_primary_color_treatment: Graduated orange ‘global’, black ‘dough’, and a graduated orange strapline
